Install

SummaReader has two editions. The free edition is on GitHub, at https://github.com/dataiza/summareader-release/releases/latest. Premium is sold in the App Store and in Google Play. Premium adds automatic summaries, summarizing many articles with one press, search, filters, tags, lists and highlights. Sync is in both editions.

Windows is not covered here. There is no Windows build yet.

Android

The free edition is an APK file, the file type Android installs apps from.

  1. On the phone, open https://github.com/dataiza/summareader-release/releases/latest in the browser.
  2. Under Assets, tap the file whose name ends in .apk, for example SummaReader-free-0.107.0.apk.
  3. When the download is complete, open the file.
  4. Android asks if the browser can install apps. Tap Settings, turn on the permission, then go back. The words on this screen are different between phone makers.
  5. Tap Install.
  6. Tap Open.

To update, download the new APK and install it over the old one. Your library stays.

Premium, from Google Play (when available): open SummaReader in Google Play and tap Install.

iPhone and iPad

From the App Store (when available): open SummaReader in the App Store and tap Get.

Until then, test builds go out through Apple's TestFlight service, by invitation. Open the invitation on the iPhone or iPad and follow its steps.

macOS

From the Mac App Store (when available): open SummaReader in the Mac App Store and click Get. The app is then in Applications.

Linux

The free edition is an AppImage: one file that runs without installation.

  1. Open https://github.com/dataiza/summareader-release/releases/latest.
  2. Under Assets, download the file whose name ends in .AppImage.
  3. Make the file executable. In a terminal: chmod +x SummaReader-free-*-x86_64.AppImage. In most file managers, the file's properties have an "executable" or "allow running" setting that does the same.
  4. Run the file.
  5. The first time, the app asks if it can add itself to your applications menu. Click yes to start it from the menu after this.

To add the app to the menu without the question, start it from a terminal with --install:

./SummaReader-free-0.113.0-x86_64.AppImage --install

This does the same as clicking yes, and then the app opens. If the app is already in the menu, nothing changes. If the menu starts an older copy, the menu starts this file after this, and the older copy is deleted.

If the app is open when you start a different file or version of it, the open copy asks: "SummaReader 0.112.0 was started. Close this version and switch to it?" Click Switch to close the open copy and start the new one. Click Not now to keep the open copy.

The AppImage updates itself when you ask: Configuration › About › Check for updates. The update replaces the file where it is. The new version starts the next time you open the app.
